entries.isnad_ar: عن قتادة عن أبي برزة الأسلمي
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عن النوم قبل العشاء والحديث بعدها.
entries.isnad_en: From Qatada, from Abu Barza al-Aslami, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade sleeping before 'Isha' and conversation after it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Ḥadīth of Mujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr · p. 98
entries.isnad_ar: عن أبان
entries.matn_ar: قال جاءت امرأة إلى أنس بن مالك فقالت إني أنام قبل العشاء فقال لا تنامي فإن هذه الآية نزلت في الذين لا ينامون قبل العشاء الآخرة: تتجافى جنوبهم عن المضاجع.
entries.isnad_en: From Aban, who said:
entries.matn_en: A woman came to Anas b. Malik and said: “I sleep before 'Isha'.” He said: “Do not sleep, for this verse was revealed concerning those who do not sleep before the last 'Isha': ‘Their sides forsake their beds.’”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Ḥadīth of Mujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr · p. 98
entries.isnad_ar: عن قتادة عن أبي الأحوص عن ابن مسعود
entries.matn_ar: قال ⦗ص: 99⦘ بينا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بعض أسفاره حتى إذا كان في وجه الصبح فإذا هو بمناد يقول الله أكبر الله أكبر فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم على الفطرة هذا ثم قال أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله قال برئ هذا من الشرك قال أشهد أن محمدا رسول الله قال خرج هذا من النار قال حي على الصلاة حي على الفلاح فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ظهر الإسلام ورب الكعبة ثم قال قد قامت الصلاة فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إن هذا لصاحب صيد أو راع مبتدئ بأهله قال فانطلق القوم يوضعون فإذا هم برجل مبتدئ بأهله فبشروه بما قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم.
entries.isnad_en: From Qatada, from Abu al-Ahwas, from Ibn Mas'ud, who said:
entries.matn_en: ⦗p. 99⦘ While the Messenger of God ﷺ was on one of his journeys, until, when it was at the approach of dawn, there was a caller saying: “God is the Greatest, God is the Greatest.” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “This one is upon the fitra.” Then he said: “I bear witness that there is no god but God.” He said: “This one is free of polytheism.” He said: “I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of God.” He said: “This one has come out of the Fire.” He said: “Come to prayer, come to success.” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Islam has become manifest, by the Lord of the Ka'ba.” Then he said: “The prayer has been established.” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “This is either a hunter or a herdsman who is beginning with his family.” He said: The people set off hurrying, and there was a man beginning with his family, and they gave him glad tidings of what the Messenger of God ﷺ had said.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Ḥadīth of Mujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr · p. 99
entries.isnad_ar: عن معمر عن الزهري عمن حدثه
entries.matn_ar: أن أبا أيوب الأنصاري قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أن تستقبل بالغائط القبلة وقال شرقوا أو غربوا ⦗ص: 100⦘ قال فقال أبو أيوب فقدمنا الشام فوجدنا مراحيض قد صنعت للقبلة فكن ننحرف ونستغفر الله عز وجل.
entries.isnad_en: From Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from one who
entries.matn_en: narrated to him: that Abu Ayyub al-Ansari said: The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade facing the qibla when relieving oneself, and said: “Turn east or west.” ⦗p. 100⦘ He said: Abu Ayyub said: “When we came to Syria, we found latrines that had been built facing the qibla, so we would turn away and seek forgiveness from God ﷻ.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Ḥadīth of Mujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr · p. 100
entries.isnad_ar: عن قتادة
entries.matn_ar: قال لما نزلت هذه الآية عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: إن الله يحب التوابين ويحب المتطهرين، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يا معشر الأنصار إن الله عز وجل قد أحسن عليكم الثناء في الطهر فما تصنعون قالوا نغسل القبل والدبر قال فاثبتوا أو قال عليكم به.
entries.isnad_en: From Qatada, who said:
entries.matn_en: When this verse was revealed to the Messenger of God ﷺ: “Indeed, God loves those who repent and loves those who purify themselves,” the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “O company of the Ansar, God ﷻ has indeed praised you well for your purity; what is it that you do?” They said: “We wash the front and the back.” He said: “Then remain firm in it”—or he said, “You must keep to it.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Ḥadīth of Mujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr · p. 100
entries.isnad_ar: عن قتادة عن معاذة العدوية عن عائشة رضي الله عنها
entries.matn_ar: قالت للنساء ⦗ص: 101⦘ مرن أزواجكن فليغسلوا عنهم أثر البول والغائط فإني أستحييهم وقد رأيت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يفعله. آخر الجزء والحمد لله رب العالمين وصلواته على رسوله سيدنا المصطفى محمد النبي وسلم تسليما إلى يوم الدين وحسبنا الله ونعم الوكيل.
entries.isnad_en: From Qatada, from Mu'adha al-'Adawiyya, from 'A'isha ﵂, who said
entries.matn_en: to the women: ⦗p. 101⦘ “Command your husbands to wash off the traces of urine and feces, for I feel shy of them; and I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ do it.” End of the part. Praise be to God, Lord of the worlds, and ﷺ upon His Messenger, our master, the Chosen One, Muhammad, the Prophet, until the Day of Judgment. God is sufficient for us, and [He is] the best Disposer of affairs.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Ḥadīth of Mujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr · p. 103
entries.matn_ar: القسم الثالث نسخة السري بن سهل الجنديسابوري عن عبد الله بن رشيد عن أبي عبيدة مجاعة بن الزبير مما لم يرد في القسمين الأولين
entries.matn_en: Section Three. The copy of al-Sari b. Sahl al-Jundisaburi, from 'Abd Allah b. Rushayd, from Abu 'Ubayda Muja'a b. al-Zubayr, of what did not occur in the first two sections.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Ḥadīth of Mujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr · p. 105
entries.isnad_ar: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قال محمد بن سهل الجنديسابوري حدثنا عبد الله بن رشيد حدثنا أبو عبيدة مجاعة بن الزبير 89 - عن أبان عن عكرمة عن ابن عباس عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ إذا لم يجد أحدكم ماء ووجد النبيذ فليتوضأ به.
entries.matn_en: In the name of God, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate. Muhammad b. Sahl al-Jundisaburi said: 'Abd Allah b. Rushayd narrated to us: Abu 'Ubayda Muja'a b. al-Zubayr narrated to us: 89 - From Aban, from 'Ikrima, from Ibn 'Abbas, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said: “If any of you does not find water but finds nabidh (date infusion), let him perform wudu' with it.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Ḥadīth of Mujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr · p. 105
entries.isnad_ar: عن أبان عن سليمان بن قيس العامري عن مسروق بن الأجدع
entries.matn_ar: قال دخلت على عائشة فقالت ما فعل يزيد بن قيس الأرحبي ⦗ص: 106⦘ لعنه الله قال قلت يا أم المؤمنين مات قالت أستغفر الله مرتين قلت يا أم المؤمنين بم استحللت لعنته ثم استغفرت قالت استحللت لعنته لأنه كان سفيرا بيني وبين علي بن أبي طالب فبلغ عني ما لم أقل وأما استغفاري فإن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم نهانا أن نلعن الأموات أو قال موتانا.
entries.isnad_en: From Aban, from Sulayman b. Qays al-'Amiri, from Masruq b. al-Ajda', who said:
entries.matn_en: I entered upon 'A'isha, and she said: “What became of Yazid b. Qays al-Arhabi—⦗p. 106⦘ may God curse him?” He said: I said: “O Mother of the Believers, he has died.” She said: “I seek God’s forgiveness,” twice. I said: “O Mother of the Believers, on what grounds did you deem it permissible to curse him, and then seek forgiveness?” She said: “I deemed it permissible to curse him because he was an emissary between me and 'Ali b. Abi Talib, and he conveyed from me what I had not said. As for my seeking forgiveness, the Messenger of God ﷺ forbade us to curse the dead”—or he said, “our dead.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Ḥadīth of Mujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr · p. 106
entries.isnad_ar: عن أبان عن مسلم بن أبي عمران الأسدي عن أبي وائل شقيق بن سلمة عن علي رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يكون في آخر الزمان قوم حدثاء الأسنان سفهاء الأحلام يقولون من أحسن الناس قولا يمرقون من الدين كما يمرق السهم من الرمية وهم شر الخلق والخليقة طوبى لمن قتلهم أو قتلوه إن لمن قتلهم عند الله أجرا.
entries.isnad_en: From Aban, from Muslim b. Abi 'Imran al-Asadi, from Abu Wa'il Shaqiq b. Salama, from 'Ali ﵁, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “At the end of time there will be a people young in years, foolish in judgment, who speak like the best of people in speech. They pass through the religion as an arrow passes through its target. They are the worst of creation and of creatures. Blessed is the one who kills them or is killed by them; indeed, for the one who kills them there is a reward with God.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Ḥadīth of Mujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr · p. 106
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ
entries.matn_ar: أن رجلا يكنى أبا إسرائيل نذر أن لا يتكلم ولا يستظل ولا يقعد ⦗ص: 107⦘ ويصوم يومه فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مروه فليتكلم وليستظل وأن يقعد وأن يصوم يومه.
entries.isnad_en: From Ayyub, from 'Ikrima, from Ibn 'Abbas:
entries.matn_en: that a man known as Abu Isra'il vowed not to speak, not to take shade, and not to sit ⦗p. 107⦘ and to fast his day. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “Command him to speak, to take shade, to sit, and to fast his day.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Ḥadīth of Mujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr · p. 107
entries.isnad_ar: عن الحسن عن مهاجر بن قنفذ
entries.matn_ar: قال سلمت عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فلم يرد علي فقمت مهموما فدعا بوضوء فتوضأ ورد علي وقال إني كرهت أن أذكر الله وأنا على غير وضوء.
entries.isnad_en: From al-Hasan, from Muhajir b. Qunfudh, who said:
entries.matn_en: I greeted the Messenger of God ﷺ with salam, but he did not return it to me. So I stood up distressed. Then he called for water for wudu' and performed wudu', and returned my greeting, and said: “I disliked to mention God while I was not in a state of wudu'.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Ḥadīth of Mujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr · p. 107
entries.isnad_ar: عن الحسن
entries.matn_ar: قال أتينا معقل بن يسار نعوده إذ جاء عبيد الله بن زياد فقال معقل سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول من استرعى رعية فلم يحطها من ورائها بالنصيحة أو مات وهو غاش لها أدخله الله نار جهنم قال له عبيد الله ألا كنت حدثتنا هذا الحديث قبل اليوم إني كنت ⦗ص: 108⦘ في سلطان سوى سلطانك.
entries.isnad_en: From al-Hasan, who said:
entries.matn_en: We came to Ma'qil b. Yasar to visit him when 'Ubayd Allah b. Ziyad arrived. Ma'qil said: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: “Whoever is entrusted with the care of a flock and does not guard it from behind with sincere counsel, or dies while deceiving it, God will enter him into the Fire of Hell.” 'Ubayd Allah said to him: “Why did you not narrate this hadith to us before today? I was ⦗p. 108⦘ under an authority other than yours.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Ḥadīth of Mujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr · p. 108
entries.isnad_ar: عن علي بن المبارك عن يحيى بن أبي كثير عن زيد بن سلام
entries.matn_ar: أن جده أبا سلام حدثه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بينما هو بالبطحاء فإذا هو برجل عليه ثياب شعر فقال السلام عليك فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وعليك فقال الراكب سبحان الله ما رأيت رجلا رد السلام قبلك فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لا إله إلا الله ما رأيت رجلا سلم قبلك فقال يا فتى من أهل مكة أنت قال نعم ولدت بها ونشأت بها قال فهل فيها محمد أو أحمد قال ما فيها محمد ولا أحمد غيري قال فاكشف عن ظهرك فكشف عن ظهره فإذا خاتم النبوة بين كتفيه فقال أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وأنك رسول الله فقال يا راكب بما أمرت قال أمرت أن تضرب أعناق قومك بالسيف حتى يشهدوا أن لا إله إلا الله وأنك رسول الله فقال له رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يا راكب ألا أزودك قال إن شئت فعلت قال فأقبل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إلى خديجة ووجهه يتهلل فقالت يا ابن عبد المطلب ما رأيتك قط أحسن تهلل وجه منك اليوم قال وما يمنعني وقد أمرت أن أضرب قومك بالسيف حتى يشهدوا أن لا إله إلا الله قالت إن هذا خليق أن لا يكون وكانت كلمة آذته بها ⦗ص: 109⦘ فقال يا خديجة هل عندك ما يزود راكبا قالت ما عندي إلا تمرات فأخذ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم التمر في طرف ردائه فقال يعني الراكب الحمد لله الذي لم يمتني ولم يخرجني من الدنيا حتى رأيت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يحمل إلي الزاد في ثوبه فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يا راكب هل لك من حاجة قال نعم أنت تدعو الله أن يعرف بيني وبينك يوم القيامة فذهب فلم ير.
entries.isnad_en: From 'Ali b. al-Mubarak, from Yahya b. Abi Kathir, from Zayd b. Sallam, that
entries.matn_en: his grandfather Abu Sallam narrated to him: that the Messenger of God ﷺ, while he was in al-Batha', came upon a man wearing garments of hair, who said: “Peace be upon you.” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “And upon you.” The rider said: “Glory be to God! I have not seen a man return the greeting before you.” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “There is no god but God! I have not seen a man give the greeting of peace before you.” He said: “O young man, are you of the people of Mecca?” He said: “Yes; I was born there and grew up there.” He said: “Is there among them Muhammad or Ahmad?” He said: “There is no Muhammad or Ahmad among them other than me.” He said: “Uncover your back.” So he uncovered his back, and there was the Seal of Prophethood between his shoulders. He said: “I bear witness that there is no god but God and that you are the Messenger of God.” He said: “O rider, what have you been commanded?” He said: “I was commanded that you strike the necks of your people with the sword until they testify that there is no god but God and that you are the Messenger of God.” The Messenger of God ﷺ said to him: “O rider, shall I not provide you with provisions?” He said: “If you wish, do so.” He said: Then the Messenger of God ﷺ went back to Khadija with his face radiant. She said: “O son of 'Abd al-Muttalib, I have never seen your face more beautifully radiant than it is today.” He said: “And what could prevent it, when I have been commanded to strike your people with the sword until they testify that there is no god but God?” She said: “This is unlikely to happen”—and it was a word with which she hurt him ⦗p. 109⦘. He said: “O Khadija, do you have anything with which to provision a rider?” She said: “I have nothing but a few dates.” The Messenger of God ﷺ took the dates in the edge of his cloak. He said—meaning the rider: “Praise be to God, who did not cause me to die nor take me out of the world until I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ carrying provisions to me in his garment.” The Messenger of God ﷺ said: “O rider, do you have any need?” He said: “Yes: that you pray to God that He make [it] known between me and you on the Day of Resurrection.” Then he went away and was not seen.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Ḥadīth of Mujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr · p. 109
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَوْفَى عَنْ عمران بن حصين
entries.matn_ar: أن رجلا عض ذراع رجل فانتزعت ثنيته فأبطلها رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم.
entries.isnad_en: From Qatada, from Zurara b. Awfa, from 'Imran b. Husayn:
entries.matn_en: that a man bit the forearm of another man, who pulled it away, so that his front tooth was pulled out, and the Messenger of God ﷺ nullified it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Ḥadīth of Mujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr · p. 109
entries.isnad_ar: عن قتادة عن العلاء بن زياد عن عمران بن حصين
entries.matn_ar: قال قال له رجل طلقت امرأتي علانية وراجعتها سرا فقال عمران طلقت في غير عدة وراجعت في غير سنة اتق الله واشهد.
entries.isnad_en: From Qatada, from al-'Ala' b. Ziyad, from 'Imran b. Husayn, who said:
entries.matn_en: A man said to him: “I divorced my wife openly and took her back secretly.” 'Imran said: “You divorced outside the waiting period ('idda), and you took her back contrary to the sunna. Fear God, and call witnesses.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Ḥadīth of Mujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr · p. 110
entries.isnad_ar: عن قتادة عن شهر بن حوشب عن عبد الرحمن بن غنم عن عمرو بن خارجة
entries.matn_ar: قال شهدت مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وهو يخطب وهو على راحلته بمنى وهو آخذ بخطامها وهي تقصع بجرتها وإن لعابها يسيل بين كتفي فقال نبي الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أيها الناس إن الله قسم لكل إنسان نصيبه من الميراث ولا يجوز لوارث وصية ألا إن الولد للفراش وللعاهر الحجر من ادعى لغير أبيه أو تولى غير مواليه رغبة عنهم فعليه لعنة الله والملائكة والناس أجمعين.
entries.isnad_en: From Qatada, from Shahr b. Hawshab, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Ghanm, from 'Amr b. Kharija, who said:
entries.matn_en: I was present with the Messenger of God ﷺ while he was delivering a sermon on his mount at Mina, and he was holding its halter, while it was chewing its cud, and its saliva was running between my shoulders. The Prophet of God ﷺ said: “O people, God has apportioned to every person his share of the inheritance, and there is no bequest for an heir. Beware: the child belongs to the bed, and for the adulterer is the stone. Whoever claims [descent from] other than his father, or attaches himself to other than his own patrons out of aversion to them, upon him is the curse of God, the angels, and all people.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Ḥadīth of Mujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr · p. 110
entries.isnad_ar: عن قتادة عن عقبة بن عبد الغافر عن أبي عبيدة عن ابن مسعود
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم استحيوا من الله حق الحياء قالوا يا رسول الله إنا لنستحيي والحمد لله قال ليس ذلك ولكن من استحيى من الله حق الحياء فليحفظ الرأس وما حوى والبطن وما وعى وليذكر الموت والبلى ومن أراد الآخرة ترك زينة الدنيا فمن فعل ⦗ص: 111⦘ ذلك فقد استحيى من الله حق الحياء.
entries.isnad_en: From Qatada, from 'Uqba b. 'Abd al-Ghafir, from Abu 'Ubayda, from Ibn Mas'ud, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Be modest before God with true modesty.” They said: “O Messenger of God, we are indeed modest, praise be to God.” He said: “That is not it; rather, whoever is modest before God with true modesty, let him guard the head and what it contains, and the stomach and what it holds, and let him remember death and decay; and whoever desires the Hereafter forsakes the adornment of this world. Whoever does ⦗p. 111⦘ that has indeed been modest before God with true modesty.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Ḥadīth of Mujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr · p. 111
entries.isnad_ar: عن قتادة عن جابر بن زيد عن ابن عباس عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ يؤتى بالشهيد يوم القيامة فينصب للحساب ويؤتى بالمتصدق فينصب للحساب ثم يؤتى بأهل البلاء ولا ينصب لهم ميزان ولا ينشر لهم ديوان فيصب عليهم الأجر صبا حتى إن أهل العافية ليتمنون في الموقف أن أجسادهم قرضت بالمقاريض من حسن ثواب الله لهم.
entries.isnad_en: From Qatada, from Jabir b. Zayd, from Ibn 'Abbas, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: “On the Day of Resurrection the martyr will be brought and set up for the reckoning; and the one who gave charity will be brought and set up for the reckoning; then the people of affliction will be brought, and no scale will be set up for them and no record will be unrolled for them, and reward will be poured over them in abundance, until the people of well-being, in the standing place, will wish that their bodies had been cut with scissors, because of the goodness of God’s reward to them.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Ḥadīth of Mujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr · p. 111
entries.isnad_ar: عن قتادة عن أبي إسحاق عن الحارث عن علي
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم من اشتاق إلى الجنة سارع إلى الخيرات ومن ⦗ص: 112⦘ أشفق من النار لهى عن الشهوات ومن ترقب الموت هانت عليه اللذات ومن زهد في الدنيا هانت عليه المصيبات.
entries.isnad_en: From Qatada, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Harith, from 'Ali, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever yearns for Paradise hastens to good deeds; and whoever ⦗p. 112⦘ fears the Fire turns away from desires; and whoever awaits death, pleasures become insignificant to him; and whoever renounces the world, calamities become light for him.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Ḥadīth of Mujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr · p. 112
entries.isnad_ar: عن هشام عن حفصة عن أم عطية
entries.matn_ar: قالت أمرنا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إن نخرجهن يوم الفطر ويوم الأضحى العواتق والحيض وذوات الخدور فأما الحيض فيعتزلن المصلى ويشهدن دعوة المسلمين قلت يا رسول الله إحدانا لا يكون لها جلباب قال فلتلبسها أختها من جلبابها.
entries.isnad_en: From Hisham, from Hafsa, from Umm 'Atiyya, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ commanded us to bring them out on the Day of Fitr and the Day of Adha: the young unmarried women, the menstruating women, and those who dwell in seclusion. As for the menstruating women, they keep apart from the prayer place and witness the supplication of the Muslims. I said: “O Messenger of God, one of us has no jilbab (outer garment).” He said: “Let her sister clothe her from her own jilbab.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Ḥadīth of Mujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr · p. 112
entries.isnad_ar: عن أبي هارون العبدي عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لما عرج به إلى السماء نظر في سماء الدنيا فإذا ⦗ص: 113⦘ رجال بطونهم كأمثال البيوت العظام قد مالت بطونهم وهم منضدون على سابلة آل فرعون يوقفون على النار كل غداة وعشي يقولون ربنا لا تقم الساعة أبدا قلت يا جبريل من هؤلاء قال هؤلاء أكلة الربا من أمتك لا يقومون إلا كما يقوم الذي يتخبطه الشيطان من المس.
entries.isnad_en: From Abu Harun al-'Abdi, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri:
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ, when he was taken up to heaven, looked at the lowest heaven, and there were ⦗p. 113⦘ men whose bellies were like great houses, their bellies sagging, and they were arranged in rows on the highway of the family of Pharaoh; they were made to stand before the Fire every morning and evening, saying: “Our Lord, never bring about the Hour.” I said: “O Jibril, who are these?” He said: “These are the devourers of usury from your community; ‘they will not rise except as rises the one whom Satan has struck with madness by [his] touch.’”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Ḥadīth of Mujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr · p. 113
entries.isnad_ar: عن أبان عن شهر عن أسماء بنت يزيد بن السكن
entries.matn_ar: قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إذا اجتمع الناس يوم القيامة أمر الله مناديا فنادى سيعلم الجمع اليوم من أولى بالكرم أين الذين لا تلهيهم تجارة ولا بيع عن ذكر الله قال فيقومون وهم قليل يدخلون الجنة ثم يرجع المنادي فينادي سيعلم الجمع اليوم من أولى بالكرم أين الذين تتجافى جنوبهم عن المضاجع قال فيقومون وهم أقل ممن النصف الأول فيدخلون الجنة قال ثم يرجع فيقول سيعلم أهل الجمع من أولى بالكرم أين الحمادون في السراء والضراء والكاظمين الغيظ والعافون عن الناس قال فيقومون وهم أقل من النصف الثاني ثم يحاسب ما بقي من الناس.
entries.isnad_en: From Aban, from Shahr, from Asma' bint Yazid b. al-Sakan, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “When people are gathered on the Day of Resurrection, God will command a caller, who will call out: ‘Today the assembly will know who is more worthy of honor. Where are those whom neither trade nor sale distracts from the remembrance of God?’” He said: “So they will stand, and they will be few, and they will enter Paradise. Then the caller will return and call out: ‘Today the assembly will know who is more worthy of honor. Where are those whose sides forsake their beds?’” He said: “So they will stand, and they will be fewer than the first half, and they will enter Paradise.” He said: “Then he will return and say: ‘Today the people of the assembly will know who is more worthy of honor. Where are those who praise [God] in prosperity and adversity, those who restrain their anger, and those who pardon people?’” He said: “So they will stand, and they will be fewer than the second half. Then the rest of the people will be reckoned with.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Ḥadīth of Mujāʿa ibn al-Zubayr · p. 114
entries.isnad_ar: عن ابن سِيرِينَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ الله صلى الله عليه وسلم من صام من رمضان في إنصاف وسكوت وكن سمعه وبصره وجوارحه من الحرام والكذب اقترب الله منه يوم القيامة حتى تمس ركبته ركبة إبراهيم.
entries.isnad_en: From Ibn Sirin, from Abu Hurayra, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever fasts [during] Ramadan with fairness and silence, and shields his hearing, his sight, and his limbs from the forbidden and from lying, God will draw near to him on the Day of Resurrection until his knee touches the knee of Ibrahim.”
